HBM_remaining_PC_gap: HBM owner is single-owner FSM; it does not establish concurrent same-tag remaining_PC counter updates. A banked pipeline must aggregate all admitted updates for a tag in one ordered commit, detect duplicate bits across queued/in-flight/committed entries, then compute completion from the resulting bitmap/count.
acquire: Check full identity/range, both SM/bank credits and persistent generation/sequence watermark BEFORE reserving either credit.
duplicate_inflight: One word_pending per owned bank word; exact ordinal required on request and capture; duplicate or stale capture refuses.
live_tags_gap: Existing one-credit per SM/bank is not a many-tag allocator. Joint same-edge allocation/retirement must produce one signed delta and maintain bitmap/generation identity; no reuse until all queued returns/outputs/reverse receipts drain.
publish: Actual both-copy write observations plus single combined H1 ACK; not two invented host ACK pins. Require fresh matching MIRRORS state before any fence mutation.
retire: Keep SM and bank credits through visibility, consumer completion and reverse acceptance. Atomically release both indexes only at matching reverse. Watermark persists.
